items.body_excerpt:
Another example of a team peel switching against the snake dribble. By sending the top player from the full-side to switch onto the ball, the defense rescues the hostage and takes away the Gortat screen.

Low-man has to read the recovery of the defender peeling off. Ideally would peel off sooner.

quote.author: Caitlin Cooper
quote.text:
Ty Jerome ranks top-five in PnR efficiency, min. 100 picks. Look at how the Pacers (literally) cut the head off the snake 

When Jerome snakes his dribble, IND brought Nembhard from the top of the full-side onto the ball w/ Smith peeling off into rotation
